information_flow: One nonbranching executable lineage: champion_engine to semantic_normalizer_engine to strength_transducer_engine. The first call changes representation only; the second performs the sole strength-bearing transformation and emits the final engine.
name: Single-Lineage Semantic Transduction

calls.objective: Transform exactly one supplied anchor engine into exactly one complete runnable canonical engine. Expose UCI handling, legal move generation, make/unmake, hashing, repetition state, evaluation state, and search state through explicit single-source transitions. Use bounded in-call executable equivalence and invariant probes, repairing only this transduction until consistent. Preserve the anchor's search policy and evaluation intent; do not introduce strength changes, alternative implementations, candidate variants, or selection.

Consume the sole canonical engine and emit exactly one complete production engine. Diagnose one highest-leverage algorithmic weakness using the supplied task, metrics, and bounded evidence; implement one coherent cross-component improvement through the canonical seams; and run bounded legality, UCI, state-integrity, and tactical sanity checks. Repair the same unfinished transformation in place if a check fails. Do not generate alternatives, compare candidate variants, reproduce the official champion loop, invoke an external verifier, attribute exact source deltas, or perform preserve-versus-rollback selection.
